subject: Executive workshop — session owners & pre-read distribution plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@halcyonhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive workshop — session owners & pre-read distribution plan

Hi all,

Thanks again for locking the dates (April 14–15) — Halcyon's onsite will be a great chance to align execs on the pilot roadmap and integration timelines. I attached a first-draft agenda and a simple pre-read matrix to get us moving.

A couple of asks to keep this tight:
- Please scan the draft agenda and confirm session owners by EOD Tue (Mar 24). I've left placeholder owners but want final names for badge printing and speaker slides.
- Pre-read owners: for each session in the matrix indicate which doc(s) will be distributed to the customer before travel. Our target is to push pre-reads to Halcyon one week before (Apr 7).
- Slide guidance: keep exec-facing slides to 6–8 slides per session; if you need more, flag it with reasons.
- Travel windows: recommend arrival the evening of Apr 13 for a 8:30 start on Apr 14. If anyone needs exceptions, call it out now so we can coordinate travel.

Attachments: draft_agenda_v0.1.pdf, pre-read_matrix.xlsx, speaker_blurbs.docx

Immediate owners I penciled in (please confirm/replace):
- Opening & goals (30m): Marissa Cole
- Product roadmap (45m): Stephanie Nguyen
- Integration scoping (40m): Monica Patel
- Cost & deployment options (35m): Karthik Iyer
- Customer Q&A + next steps (20m): Alex Turner (Halcyon)

If anyone thinks a session should be split or shortened, list the rationale and preferred owner in your reply. I'll collate and send the version we'll share with Halcyon.

Thanks —
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive workshop — session owners & pre-read distribution plan

Karthik — thanks, looks good. Quick mapping from my side:

- Opening & goals (Marissa) — I'll do a 10-slide 12-minute set with 2 slides of customer success metrics. Will send blurb by Tue.
- Roadmap (Stephanie) — agree 45m; add a 5-minute demo slot mid-session for the new routing policy.
- Integration scoping (Monica) — suggest splitting into two 20m blocks (API/infra + security/compliance) with separate owners; Monica + Karthik.
- Cost & deployment options (Karthik) — recommend moving this to second day AM so execs have the context from Day 1.

Pre-read items I'm committing to own: Exec summary (2 pages) and success metrics appendix. I uploaded initial text to the Drive link you shared.

One logistics note: can we confirm rooms are set for roundtable seating for breakout #2? If not, I'll ask onsite to switch.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive workshop — session owners & pre-read distribution plan

Thanks — two small adjustments from product:

1) Roadmap session timing: pare to 30m of presentation + 15m for a live demo (we can do 10 min of demo, 5 min of Q/A). That gives room for integration scoping later.
2) Travel: our engineering presenter plans to arrive Apr 14 morning due to client support obligations; Monica will cover their portion in the morning and hand off the deep-dive to them in the afternoon.

I'll update the slide guidance in the agenda doc and flag any follow-ups on slide counts.

- Stephanie

Date: Mon, 23 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive workshop — session owners & pre-read distribution plan

Karthik — appreciate the plan and quick turnaround. A few items from Halcyon side:

- Procurement has been looped for the reserved room block and travel reimbursements — procurement@halcyonhealth.com is your contact for invoices and PO details.
- For pre-reads: we prefer single PDFs per session (max 8 pages) rather than multiple docs. Can you confirm each session will have one consolidated PDF?
- Slide counts: execs want a 2-slide TL;DR for each session stapled at the front of the packet.
- Dietary restrictions: sending an internal note — please advise if any of your presenters have common restrictions (vegetarian/gluten-free).

We'll review the draft agenda and confirm any conflicts by Wed (Mar 25).

Best,
Alex Turner
Director, Strategic Partnerships — Halcyon Health

Alex / team — thanks for the quick replies and clear asks. Finalizing actions below so we have an owner for each item: 

ACTION ITEMS (owners & due dates):
- Confirm session owners and any swaps (owners: Marissa/Stephanie/Monica/Karthik) — due Tue Mar 24 EOD
- Convert pre-reads to single-session PDFs (owner: Marissa + Stephanie for product sessions) — due Tue Apr 7
- Prepare 2-slide TL;DR for each session (owner: all presenters) — due Tue Apr 7
- Badge names & arrival confirmations (owner: Monica) — due Tue Apr 7
- Dietary restrictions list (owner: Marissa) — due Wed Mar 25
- Procurement contact: Alex will coordinate with procurement@halcyonhealth.com for invoicing and PO.

I updated the Drive folder with a clean copy of the agenda (v0.2) and a template for the 2-slide TL;DR. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AExAMPLE-workshop-2026

Attachments included originally: draft_agenda_v0.1.pdf, pre-read_matrix.xlsx, speaker_blurbs.docx. I'll produce the v0.2 pdf once owners are confirmed.

If there are no other objections, I'll share the customer-facing agenda on Wed after collating confirmations.

Thanks — see you all in April.

Karthik
